`v2.15.22-state.json` was generated by running the unmodified `public/gacha-lab/index.html` from commit `4ddab85` in an isolated Chromium context. It contains generated example data only, never user data.

Actions: force Math.random to zero; custom 40 draws; standard 10 draws; configure badge → wolf collectible trade (cost 20, quantity 2, repeat allowed); redeem once; copy current configuration; single draw in the copy. IDs come from the original page's crypto.randomUUID. This captures two independent pools, counts, collection, duplicates, converted currency, redeemedSpent, tradeGained, spent, history and batchStats using the actual released writer. Compatibility tests verify exact no-write loading, continued drawing, preservation of the other pool, reload, and full backup round trips. A derived pre-v1.22 fixture additionally exercises versions, old `to` and reward-based `redeemFrom` rules.
